name: ytmusic
title: YouTube Music
description: Browse YouTube Music's home shelves, charts, moods and genres, albums, artists, playlists and history; search with filters; play and download audio with mpv and yt-dlp.
author: black

commands.name: browse
commands.title: Browse YouTube Music
commands.description: Search YouTube Music as you type, browse its home shelves, charts and moods, and open albums, artists, playlists and your library.

commands.name: now-playing
commands.title: Now Playing
commands.description: Control the shared mpv: pause, resume, skip, go back and stop.

preferences.name: cookies
preferences.title: Cookies
preferences.description: The Cookie request header of a signed-in music.youtube.com tab. Leave empty for guest browsing.

preferences.name: cookiesFile
preferences.title: Cookies File
preferences.description: Read when Cookies is empty: Sonora's credentials.json, or a file holding the header. ~ is expanded.

preferences.name: authUser
preferences.title: Auth User
preferences.description: The Google account index the cookies belong to, for a browser signed into several accounts.

preferences.name: player
preferences.title: Player
preferences.description: Player command used by Play. Leave empty to use mpv.

preferences.name: playerArgs
preferences.title: Player Arguments
preferences.description: Extra arguments for the player, split like a shell splits them. Leave empty for none.

preferences.name: playerWindow
preferences.title: Show the Player Window
preferences.label: Open mpv in its own window
preferences.description: Off: mpv plays headless. On: mpv opens a window. A running player restarts in the new mode on the next play.

preferences.name: downloadDir
preferences.title: Download Folder
preferences.description: Where Download Audio and Download All write their MP3s. ~ is expanded.
